verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents building custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge base, or sharing them. The closest item is a help-center index line about installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills. That describes extensions to the main assistant, an adjacent feature rather than standalone custom assistants with persona instructions and attached knowledge, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
